tagline.zh: 两名打捞潜水员闯进被海水吞没的城市，用捡来的武器对付失控的港口机械。
tagline.en: Two salvage divers push through a drowned city, turning scavenged weapons on harbour machines gone rogue.

desc.en: Finish a run, win or lose.
Clear the game without using a continue.

desc.zh: 在一局里用过全部五种拾取武器。
desc.en: Pick up all five salvaged weapons in one run.
Clear the game with two players.

how.zh: 向前奔跑、跳跃、射击，可以朝八个方向开火。按住下可以卧倒，按住下再按跳跃可以从薄平台落下。被敌人或子弹碰到一次就损失一条生命，掉进水里也一样。击落飞过的运输机，拾取它掉下的弹药罐可以换一种武器，阵亡后换回铆钉枪。每一关的尽头有一台多部件的首领，打掉外层部件才能攻击核心。打通三关即通关；生命和续关都用完则失败。
how.en: Run, jump and shoot in eight directions. Hold down to go prone; hold down and press jump to drop through a thin platform. One touch from an enemy or a shot costs a life, and so does falling into the water. Shoot down the couriers that fly past and pick up the canisters they drop to change weapon; you fall back to the rivet gun when you lose a life. Each stage ends in a boss built from several parts: break the outer parts to reach the core. Clear all three stages to win; the run is lost when lives and continues are both used up.

name.zh: 移动 / 瞄准 / 卧倒

note.zh: 决定初始生命与续关次数、敌人子弹的速度和敌人出现的频率。
note.en: Sets starting lives and continues, the speed of enemy shots and how often enemies appear.

screenshot_alt.zh: 《潮汐奔袭》局内画面：潜水员在被淹没的大道上向机械敌人开火。
screenshot_alt.en: Tide Runners in play: a diver firing at machines on the drowned boulevard.

art_alt.zh: 《潮汐奔袭》主视觉：两名身穿潜水服的打捞员站在被淹没城市的屋顶上，远处是巨大的港口机械。
art_alt.en: Tide Runners key art: two salvage divers in suits on a rooftop of a flooded city, a huge harbour machine in the distance.
